extraction_notes: The main article states that detailed performance is in Table S5 of the Supporting Information, but the SI table is not included in the supplied text. Consequently, the numeric performance entries above are read from Figure 5 and marked approximate. Figure 5b provides approximate MeOH and CO STY only for Inx/ZrO2 loadings 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, and 5 wt % at 280 °C. Kinetic plots in Figures 6–7 report rates under varying partial pressures but the necessary full condition table is in the missing SI (Table S1), so those dense kinetic data were not extracted.
